The [[Miniature Kanaxai]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[Kanaxai]], the Demon from [[The Deep]].

==Acquisition==
;[[The Battle Isles]]
*[[Embark Beach]]
**[[Quest]] reward for completing [[Miniature Companion: The Deep]] {{gray|(untradeable version)}}
;Historical
*Japan Region
**Guild Wars Championship in Japan #1 team (up to 8 members) 
**Taiwan region Nightfall title contest prizes (6 were given) 
**Taiwan region friend introduction event prizes (12 were given)
* Contest
**[[Halloween Art Contest (2007)]] (1 prize)
**[[Wintersday Art Contest (2007)]] (1 prize)

==Notes== 
*Adding the above statistics there was once a total of 28 tradeable Mini Kanaxais in the game.
**After the duplication exploit, there were countless high-end miniature pets that were lost due to accounts being permanently banned. The actual number of these remaining in the game is impossible to determine.
*The [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|20th Anniversary Celebration update]] added an untradeable version of this miniature to the game.
